method: Production Electron build, Playwright-driven desktop navigation and main-window IPC, physical USB device over the built-in ADB transport. The disposable app hosted a local WebView with debugging enabled.

checks.sidebar: Selected the single USB Android device in the overview and verified all seven navigation buttons were enabled.
checks.interactiveShell: Typed a printf command into the desktop terminal and observed the expected output from the device.
checks.logcat: Emitted a unique test message from the device shell and observed its tag and text on the desktop log stream.
checks.cleanup: Uninstalled the disposable WebView fixture and verified its package was absent from the device user application list.
